summary: Allow admins to auth unauthorized users

comments.content:
Enhancement to permit admins to authorize users. Also removes the "give
exadv1 primary admin" feature- since then he could auth himself and other
people using the patch. To authorize an unauth'd user simply click the
"authorize" link on the "list users/keys" page off the admin console.

Updated to isno branch of code. Also implements "Monkeyize" from Issue 58. Adds 2
text links to the list users/keys page of the admin console.
